claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush works well and straightens hair effectively, including on thick, wavy, or curly hair.
Several reviewers praise how easy and fast it is to use, saving time compared to a flat iron.
A few reviewers report the product failed or malfunctioned, including sparking/stopping and an LCD error preventing temperature control.
Some reviewers say it does not work well on fine or short hair, with bristles not reaching through the hair or hurting the scalp.
A few reviewers note it may not fully straighten hair, requiring a follow-up with a flat iron or leaving hair fluffy.
